literal_meaning: উঠার সময় এবং বসার সময় (while getting up and sitting down)
figurative_meaning_en: at any time; all the time
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে উঠতে বসতে আমার কথা ভাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He thinks of me all the time.
history: This idiom is often associated with folk proverbs and songs depicting constant worry or remembrance, such as the line 'উঠিতে বসিতে করি বাপান্ত' from traditional Bengali oral literature.
note: The idiom evokes the rhythm of daily life, emphasizing persistence in thoughts or actions.
